description: Electricity consumption in GWH is a dataset listed in Bahrain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Electricity and Water Authority. Consumption of electricity which is produced from the power stations. Source: Electricity and Water Authority. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under Energy and Water. Its keywords are Electricity, Electricity and Water. The portal shows 18 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
